svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 715 mm of 40 x 40 x 1.6 tube; square and deburr both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure from the pole end (the end that goes between the cleats).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cleat bolts: two 6.6 mm holes across the side faces, 13 mm from the pole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end, 10 mm above and below the centre line. Drill through both sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Brace clip bolts: two 6.6 mm holes down through top and bottom, on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line, 259 and 293 mm from the pole end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Head plate bolts: two 6.6 mm holes down through top and bottom, on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line, 590 and 700 mm from the pole end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Use a drill stand so every hole goes square through both walls.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit a 6 mm aluminium crush sleeve inside at every bolt so the tube

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: walls are not squeezed in; push a plastic cap into the road end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The radar head axis is 700 mm from the pole axis.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay it on the bench; the hole rows line up along the centre.
